artworks.title: Christ on the Cross Between the Virgin and Saint John
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with a religious figure on the cross, flanked by two figures in prayerful poses. The central figure is depicted with a halo and an inscription above the cross. The two figures on either side are wearing long robes, also with halos. The background features a city with architectural elements like towers and a landscape of hills and trees. The ground is adorned with what appear to be bones or stones.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image shows three figures - a man, a woman, and a child. The woman is seated at the base of a tree with the child on her lap, while the man leans over from behind her. The man has a long beard and curly hair, with a cloak over his shoulders. The woman wears a long dress and a headscarf, and the child appears to be unclothed. The scene is set in a landscape with buildings, castles, a fence, and shrubbery visible in the background.

artworks.title: Emperor Maximilian I in the Guise of Saint George
artworks.medium: etching (iron) with open biting, plate bitten twice
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.7 x 15.7 cm (8 15/16 x 6 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a man in profile from the waist up. He is standing sideways with his hands together, one hand resting on the other, and looking forward. His facial features are strong, with a prominent nose and chin, and he has shoulder-length hair beneath a broad hat. The man wears a robe with a rich fur-like texture and a collar adorned with small carved figures. Surrounding him are angelic figures, one holding a banner and another supporting a shield. The background features stylized clouds and mountains. An ornate staff is inset at the bottom near the man. There is a faint circular halo or disc outlined behind his head.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Artist with His Younger Brother, Augustin Saint-Aubin
artworks.artist: Imitator of Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.medium: graphite and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two individuals from the waist up. One is leaning towards the right, looking downwards, while the other is facing left with a three-quarter profile, looking at the first person. The person on the left has a high forehead and detailed curls in their hair, tied at the back. The person on the right has a sharp nose and styled hair with curls. Both are wearing formal clothing, including coats with button details and textured fabric. The individual on the left appears to have a vest or waistcoat under their coat. The background has cross-hatched shading for contrast and depth.

artworks.title: The Holy Trinity in the Tree of Life Adored by Franciscans
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper with later framing line in brown ink; laid down
artworks.description: This is an image of a tree with a group of robed figures gathered around it. Above the tree, there are two figures sitting on clouds, with a dove emerging from a light aura. The scene includes small flame-like figures around the radiating beams of light. The tree visually connects the earthly gathering with the divine scene above. The composition is balanced and the line work is delicate, emphasizing the connection between the earthly and celestial realms.

artworks.title: The Holy Trinity in the Tree of Life, Adored by Franciscans
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.5 × 19.5 cm (7 11/16 × 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large tree with an assembly of religious figures gathered below it. The tree has wide branches and is surrounded by robed figures. Above the tree on clouds are two seated figures with radiant light. An eagle is positioned between the tree and the clouds. The figures below appear enraptured, with a small structure in the background. The drawing emphasizes the cloaks, tree bark, and the light and clouds.

artworks.title: Battle of the Foot Soldiers with Lances
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 22.2 x 19.7 cm (8 3/4 x 7 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval battle scene. The drawing shows two groups of armored soldiers fighting in front of a medieval castle with pointed towers and battlements. The soldiers are using long pikes and lances in combat. Fallen soldiers and skewed weapons are scattered in the foreground. In the background, there are rolling hills and structures. The drawing is detailed, showing armor, weaponry, and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Tournament on the Occasion of the Festivity of the Marriage
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 21.9 x 19.6 cm (8 5/8 x 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures engaged in combat. The composition includes two figures clad in full armor, each holding a long staff, positioned on opposite sides. An audience of onlookers is gathered behind a barricade or wooden fence. Figures can be seen watching from windows or a balcony above. The background features historical or medieval architecture with multi-storied buildings and decorative elements. The use of linework creates texture and depth in a style reminiscent of historical engraving or woodcut techniques.

artworks.title: Alexander and the High Priest of Jerusalem
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 24.8 x 19.6 cm (9 3/4 x 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print of a kneeling figure before a standing figure with an architectural dome in the background. The scene is set on a rugged landscape. The kneeling figure is adorned in classical armor and a plumed helmet, while the standing figure wears a long robe and a large, distinctively shaped hat. The structure in the background is a large dome with ornate columns. Above the scene, the sky is portrayed with a stylized cloud. The image is rendered in a highly detailed black and white engraving style.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Bernard
artworks.description: The image shows three figures within an intricate architectural setting. The central figure is a woman with long hair partially covered by a headscarf, holding an elaborate object. She wears a detailed garment and a halo above her head. An infant with a halo sits on her lap. Kneeling before them is a man with a shaved head, wearing heavy garments and holding a crozier or staff. The background depicts a townscape with towers and houses, trees, and a clear sky. The architectural elements are intricately carved with decorative patterns and motifs.

artworks.title: Venus Lamenting Adonis
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper, laid down

artworks.title: Michelangelo
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in profile, facing right, showing only his head and upper shoulders. He has a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and a furrowed brow. His hair is short, wavy, and graying. He wears a plain robe or shirt. There is an ornate arch-shaped frame around the portrait with scrollwork decorations. Below the portrait, there is a Latin inscription with the individual's identity and age. The background is a plain shaded area, contrasting with the detailed frame.

artworks.title: Saint Martin with His Horse in a Ship
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder, and Lucas van Doetechum, after Hieronymus Bosch
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.7 x 42.9 cm (13 1/4 x 16 7/8 in.)

artworks.title: The Stag Hunt
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a hunting scene from a high vantage point. The landscape includes a forest, distant structures, hills, and trees. The engraving features detailed line work to depict figures and surroundings. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white for contrast. Elements like a flag and a bird are present in the border. A hunt is taking place with hunters on horseback, dogs, and wildlife throughout the scene.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals in a detailed composition. In the foreground, a woman is seated on the ground holding a small, unclothed child on her lap. Surrounding them are several men interacting with the child. Some animals, including a horse and a bull, are in the background. The scene includes architecture with tall columns and beams, along with several other figures. The color scheme is mainly brown and ochre, with intricate details suggesting a narrative or symbolic theme.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Jeu des Mythologie"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cherubic figure reclining amidst a classical scene. The figure sits atop a block of stone with wings visible behind. The background depicts various figures seated on clouds in the sky. Some figures appear to gesture towards others. Below, there is a horse-drawn chariot advancing across waves. The stone block is decorated with foliage, urns and fluted columns.

artworks.title: Vulcan and Thetis
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures, a man and a woman engaged in conversation. The man stands upright holding a staff or hammer, wearing a cloth around his waist with wild unkempt hair. The woman faces him, gesturing with her left hand, neatly styled hair, and wearing a flowing gown with gathered waist and long sleeves. An anvil and tools are scattered on the ground, implying a workshop or forge setting. The background has a textured, vertical hatching pattern.

artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda; Cephalus and Procris; Hippomene and Atalantus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three distinct scenes. The first scene on the left depicts a figure in a reclining pose leaning against a large rock, with a creature in the background appearing to surface from water and a figure wielding a weapon soaring in from above. The middle scene presents a figure on their knees in a natural, grassy setting, accompanied by a seated animal under the shade of a tree. The third scene on the right showcases two figures in a dynamic posture in an open landscape with trees in the distance. Each scene is rendered in a detailed and realistic style with strong emphasis on lines and shading to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: Mythological Playing Cards
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grid of nine individual scenes. Each scene depicts dynamic interactions featuring figures, animals, and intricate settings. The scenes show movement, interaction, and tension. The style of the drawing is detailed and reminiscent of classical etching techniques, with a focus on fine lines and textures.

artworks.title: Mythological Playing Cards
artworks.description: This is a drawing of eleven distinct scenes featuring mythological or allegorical figures. The artwork is composed of a grid with spaces for various small illustrations, each depicting an individual vignette. In the top row, four scenes are visible: a figure holding a scythe, another figure with a bird, an interaction with an eagle, and a person among swirling clouds. The middle row presents figures in tranquil settings: a person with a peacock-like bird, in a chariot drawn by birds, amidst nature holding a small shield, and with a large shield. The final row includes figures: with a lyre, appearing assertive and standing tall, with a staff, and posed with light drapery exuding confidence. Each scene is rendered intricately, focusing on classical imagery and expressions, encapsulated within a structured format.

artworks.title: Mythological Playing Cards
artworks.description: This drawing shows a series of ten narrative scenes. Each scene features multiple figures engaged in various activities. The top row includes solo and paired compositions in landscapes with nature elements. The second row shows more dynamic poses, with figures gesturing broadly. The bottom row continues with dynamic interactions, including draped garments, expressive gestures, and animals. The overall presentation is etched with fine lines and shading techniques typical of detailed narrative illustrations.

artworks.title: Mythological Playing Cards
artworks.description: This print shows twelve small scenes arranged in three rows of four. The small scenes are rectangular, and there are stretches of white paper between the rows. Each small, distinct scene illustrates dynamic interactions with people engaged in various activities. Each panel is detailed, focusing on the gestures and expressions of the characters. Some of the scenes include: a battle with people being shot by arrows; a person riding a chariot; three women standing together holding hands; a woman running, her fingers beginning to turn into branches; a man and horses falling from the sky; a person playing the violin outside of a city; people dancing under trees; a person riding a large fish over the water, playing an instrument. The illustrations are in thin, dark lines against a background of off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures within an ornamental frame. The figure on the left is lying in a reclining position, partially unclothed. He has distinct facial features with a beard, long hair, and a halo. The figure on the right is seated or kneeling, with a draped cloth partially covering her head. She has a serene expression and a halo with rays extending outward. Both figures are surrounded by intricate floral and vine patterns in the background.

artworks.title: The Virgin Nursing the Christ Child  with Four Angels
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval-style woodcut illustration with a central figure, a woman seated, holding an infant on her lap. The woman gazes at the child, with softly rendered facial features and wavy hair, wearing flowing garments. Both figures have halos. Around them are other figures, likely angels with wings and robes, each with a halo. The background is filled with foliage and grapevines.
